Winter’s End by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Winter’s End is in the heart of historic Seagrove. Modern and wonderfully decorated with distinctive art, the courtyard home was built for luxury living and convenience. With 2,922 sq. ft, it comfortably sleeps 12. Your entire family will love this luxurious beach sanctuary with a private saltwater pool and spa.

The serene courtyard oasis, complete with comfortable lounge chairs, can be accessed at several points, including a primary bedroom. Your crew will also take advantage of the complimentary 4-seater golf cart, for zooming to the beaches, shops, and eateries. Or cruise around on one of the 4 complimentary bikes. Never a dull moment. Check out the stunningly designed interiors and the peaceful screened-in porch on the second floor. With high ceilings, rustic wood beams, and a gas fireplace, the expansive and handsome ground-floor living area is undeniably unique. The living room, with a large TV, has lots of plush, comfortable seating. The dining area includes seating for 8, along with a side table for 4, which doubles as a game table for rainy days. The impressive chef’s kitchen is equipped with two large sinks, a 5-burner gas range, double wall ovens, and 2 Bosch dishwashers. An exquisite, large quartzite island has additional seating for 5. A guest bedroom, queen, with a Smart TV, is next to the shared hall bath. A primary bedroom, king, is just as fabulous and includes a massive walk-in shower with multiple shower heads, a double quartzite vanity, and a private water closet. The second floor includes two guest bedrooms and a shared full bath with a double vanity and tub/shower combo. Relax on the large three-sided screened-in porch, overlooking the courtyard, which includes a comfy swinging seat, a loveseat, a side table, and outdoor fans. For a truly unique beach escape, take a dip in Winter's End! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 860 steps (.4 miles) to the beach (San Juan Public Beach Access) - Deeded Beach Access - 4 bedroom, 3 bath - 2922 sq ft - Large 8'x20' saltwater pool - (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Gas grill - Wi-Fi included - 4 bikes included - Complimentary 4-seater gas golf cart - Parking limited to 3 vehicles with no street parking - Dogs allowed under 50 lb ($210 non-refundable fee) Overnight: - King in primary bedroom 1st floor; private shower; TV - Queen 1st floor; hall shower; TV - King with twin/twin bunks in 2nd floor guest room; shared hall bath with tub/shower; TV - Queen with twin/twin bunks in 2nd floor guest room; shared hall bath with tub/shower; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
